capture.settings: The game used its authored film grain. Setting r.FilmGrain.CacheTextureConstants=0 made it recalculate the normalization in the captured frame.
capture.comparison: Replayed the captured frame with the original shader, with workgroup barriers around its LDS exchanges, and with the production shader dumped from a live retail run. The last two matched byte for byte at all three reduction stages, the tonemap draw and the final menu draw.

reference.method: Decode the captured texture, sum each channel in float64 and divide 16384 by each sum. Compare every GPU reduction texel to the sum of the corresponding source region.

tonemap.measurement: Count pixels over each 8-bit green-channel threshold before the menu UI is drawn.

before.repeatability: The unsynchronized reduction produced different constants across replays.
